body:
### Summary

Running `scripts/build-trampolines.sh` currently fails with:

```text
error: ".../nightly-2026-01-21-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/lib/rustlib/src/rust/library/Cargo.lock"
does not exist, unable to build with the standard library, try:
        rustup component add rust-src --toolchain nightly-2026-01-21-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
```

## Cause

The script reads the toolchain from `crates/uv-trampoline/rust-toolchain.toml`, which currently specifies `nightly-2026-01-21`.

However, `crates/uv-trampoline/Dockerfile` still uses:

```dockerfile
ARG RUST_NIGHTLY=nightly-2025-11-02
```

As a result, the Docker image does not contain `rust-src` for the toolchain used by the build script.

The Dockerfile was pinned to `nightly-2025-11-02` in #18665, while `rust-toolchain.toml` was later updated:

- `2025-11-02` → `2025-12-12` in [#19600](https://github.com/yhay81/oss-agent/issues/19600)
- `2025-12-12` → `2026-01-21` in [#20275](https://github.com/yhay81/oss-agent/issues/20275)

The Dockerfile was not updated alongside those changes.

## Why the reproducibility check did not catch this

The `trampoline_repro_changed` filter in `.github/workflows/plan.yml` only matches:

```text
^crates/uv-trampoline/.*\.rs$
^crates/uv-trampoline-builder/trampolines/
```

It does not include `rust-toolchain.toml` or the Dockerfile.

Therefore, only the trampoline reproducibility check was skipped for [#20275](https://github.com/yhay81/oss-agent/issues/20275). The regular trampoline jobs still ran successfully.

## Binary-size impact

Regenerating the launchers with the correct toolchain increases the AArch64 binaries by about 4.6 KB:

| Binary | Current `main` | Toolchain sync only | With [#19374](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/issues/19374) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| `aarch64-console` | 45,568 | 50,176 | 41,472 |
| `aarch64-gui` | 46,592 | 51,200 | 41,984 |
| `x86_64-console` | 45,056 | 45,056 | 36,864 |

`test_launchers_are_small` requires each launcher to be smaller than `50 * 1024` bytes. The regenerated `aarch64-gui` launcher is exactly 51,200 bytes, so it fails the strict `< 51,200` check.

Because this test runs on `windows-11-arm`, synchronizing the toolchain alone would cause CI to fail.

The toolchain synchronization therefore needs to be merged together with the fix for [#19374](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/issues/19374), which reduces the launcher sizes.

### Platform

Windows 11 (x86_64) / Docker Desktop

### Version

uv 0.11.28

### Python version

_No response_
title: `scripts/build-trampolines.sh` fails because the Docker image uses an outdated nightly toolchain
